_: Search bounds for fields the catalogue reports no clamp for, read by knobs.load_declared_bounds. `bounds` holds only SONARE_TUNABLE engine constants, keyed <file stem>.<kName>; the clamp check labels them `declared range (file)`, and reports a mismatch with a range the source declares itself (`declared range (macro)`). Patch fields belong in patch_clamp.h (the probe then reports the bound to the catalogue), so the proposals for them are listed separately under `patch_fields_pending_clamp` and are not search bounds until patch_clamp.h carries them.
